chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from Samāʿah, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:

Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: “The man and the woman are not to be stoned until four witnesses testify against them to intercourse, penetration, and insertion like the kohl-stick in the kohl-container.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ شُهَدَاءَ: four witnesses; the required number of witnesses for establishing the offense
key_terms.الْإِدْخَالِ: insertion; explicit bodily insertion required in the testimony
key_terms.الْإِيلَاجِ: penetration; entry that legally establishes the act
key_terms.الْجِمَاعِ: sexual intercourse; the act being testified to
key_terms.كَالْمِيلِ فِي الْمُكْحُلَةِ: like the kohl-stick in the kohl-container; a simile expressing unmistakable direct observation
key_terms.لَا يُرْجَمُ: is not to be stoned; indicates the legal punishment is not applied without due proof

ai.seo_question: What level of witness testimony is required before rajm can be carried out in a zina case?
ai.summary: This hadith states a strict judicial standard for establishing the offense that entails rajm (stoning). It requires the testimony of four witnesses who have directly observed the act in explicit detail, indicating the gravity of the punishment and the high evidentiary threshold in Islamic legal rulings.
